description: This is a test class for the HelpConfigService in the OrangeHRM Help plugin, containing setup and two test methods to verify configuration values.

classes.name: HelpConfigServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing HelpConfigService behavior, including setup and two test cases for help processor class and help URL.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the HelpConfigService instance and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testGetHelpProcessorClass
methods.description: Verifies that getHelpProcessorClass returns the expected class name 'ZendeskHelpProcessor'.

methods.name: testGetBaseHelpUrl
methods.description: Verifies that getBaseHelpUrl returns the expected URL 'https://starterhelp.orangehrm.com'.
